cause:stale-pathing-masks-are-not-the-ca.text: Stale pathing masks are not the cause: spawn/despawn bump the climb generation and clear reachability, and per-tick ladder-join caches reset every tick.

cause:suspected-escape-bug-in-the-mod-a-.text: Suspected escape bug in the mod (a colonist lowering the control ladder, a pawn climbing a raised ladder, or a hauler reaching the floor another way): the fault was in the test setup, a portable ladder cannot be raised; ExplosiveKnockback behaved correctly.

cause:the-9-4-kg-reading-was-not-the.text: The 9.4 kg reading was not the locker's real capacity: it was the empty storage filter refusing guns (8 kg locker plus one revolver); LWM's 58 kg cap applies only once the filter is fixed.

cause:the-flowworks-reach-veto-relativev.text: The FlowWorks reach veto (RelativeVeto) or the job never being offered was suspected but not the cause; the live job log showed the duplicate-pickup retarget instead.

cause:the-ticket-s-named-lines-rm-knockb.text: The ticket's named lines RM_KnockbackProof.cs:755 and :1285 are not leaks: Stage/Verdict already restore on throw (checker fix af61b9c206); the 7 new hits were none in RM_KnockbackProof.cs.

cause:the-visit-2-barrage-failure-was-no.text: The visit-2 barrage failure was not caused by the mod's barrage: the three 'barrage worst' frames (153.9/65.3/155.2 ms) all fall outside the 0.9-8.25 s window; mod-on in-window worst was 28.9/25.8/75.3 ms.
